subject: Orbit Analytics integration — account ownership & launch ops
messages:
From: Liam Carter <liam@orbit-analytics.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Grace Nguyen <grace@orbit-analytics.com>
Date: Sun, 12 Sep 2027 09:04:00 -0700
Subject: Orbit Analytics integration — kickoff and account mapping

Hi Soojin / Marissa,

Thanks again for the demo last week — Orbit is excited about the Redwood runtime for our ingestion+analytics feature set. Legal asked that we lock down account ownership and a short mutual action plan before we finalize the SOW.

Attached is a draft SOW (Orbit_SOW_v1.pdf) and a quick list of target accounts we expect to pilot in Q4. Primary asks:
- Can Redwood confirm which internal rep will own registration / primary AM for each listed account?
- We have overlap on 5 named accounts that sit in both of our AP/SE regions — proposal: partner-led for west coast, Redwood-led for east coast. Doable?

Quick timeline suggestion:
1) Sign SOW (DocuSign) — target 9/20
2) Pilot kickoff & integration owner assignment — target 9/27
3) GA launch & joint press — mid Oct

Attachments: Orbit_SOW_v1.pdf (application/pdf, 2 pages)

Thanks — happy to jump on a 30-min call to walk through mapping.

— Liam

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>

Cc: Liam Carter <liam@orbit-analytics.com>, Grace Nguyen <grace@orbit-analytics.com>
Date: Sun, 12 Sep 2027 11:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Orbit Analytics integration — kickoff and account mapping

Marissa / Ben / Jordan — quick internal sync before we confirm back to Orbit.

Summary of ask from Orbit: they want clear account ownership for pilot accounts and SOW signoff next week. They proposed partner-led for west coast / Redwood-led for east coast on overlapping accounts.

Notes from my side:
- We already have registered pipeline for three of the named accounts under Marissa (NovaPulse, Alder Health, FathomRetail). Those should remain Redwood-owned for now; partner can be co-sell on NovaPulse only.
- For the remaining overlap set (CascadeSoft, Meridian Insights), I recommend we accept partner primary in West and Redwood in East but we need explicit deal registration windows (30 days) to protect motions.
- Ben: pricing concessions — if we give partner primary on CascadeSoft we should ask for a 10% co-sell referral credit and put a revenue-weighted attribution in the SOW.
- Jordan: will want engineering SLA on integration support (we should add a 2-week implementation SLA into the SOW).

Action items for thread:
- Marissa: prepare a one-sheet account-mapping + owner names.
- Ben: draft language for referral credit and add to SOW redlines.
- Jordan: confirm engineering availability for a 9/27 pilot kickoff (30-60h over two weeks).

I'll send Orbit a consolidated mapping + proposed SOW redlines by EOD tomorrow unless someone objects.

Soojin Lee
Head of Alliances, Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.com

Date: Mon, 13 Sep 2027 10:23:00 -0700
Subject: Proposed account mapping (preview)

Soojin / team / Orbit — attaching a quick mapping (Orbit_Account_Mapping.xlsx) with proposed owners. Pulling out the overlap accounts and my recommendations:

- NovaPulse: Redwood AM (Marissa) — Redwood primary, Orbit co-sell (limited to pilot), deal registered in HubSpot under ORBIT-4981
- CascadeSoft: Orbit primary (Liam) in west region; Redwood primary (Marissa) in east region. 30-day registration protection, referral credit 10% if Orbit closes.
- Meridian Insights: Redwood-led; suggest Redwood handles contract and Orbit provides integration services.
- Alder Health: Redwood primary (previously registered)
- FathomRetail: Redwood primary

I added columns for 'primary_contact', 'requested_credits', and 'technical_owner'. Please review and flag changes — I'll update and send to Orbit tomorrow with SOW redlines.

Attachment: Orbit_Account_Mapping.xlsx (spreadsheet, 1 sheet)

— Marissa

Thanks Marissa — the mapping looks good overall. A couple of notes from Orbit: 
- We need a clearer definition in the SOW for 'co-sell' vs 'partner-led' (we propose language in clause 3.1).
- For CascadeSoft, Orbit wants primary ownership for the nation-wide account if we can demonstrate >2 pilot conversions during the first 45 days. Can we add a conversion-based reversion clause?
- Attached are our legal redlines to the SOW (Orbit_SOW_v1_redlines.pdf). Please review.

Date: Wed, 15 Sep 2027 17:42:00 -0700
Subject: Final: Orbit SOW & account ownership — confirmation

Liam / Grace — thanks for the quick turnaround.

We reviewed your redlines and internal mapping. Proposed final positions below so we can move to signature:

1) Ownership: Accept Orbit primary for CascadeSoft in west region; Redwood primary east. Add 45-day conversion-trigger clause: if >2 paid conversions during pilot window (45 days post-kickoff), primary ownership converts to Orbit nationwide. Marissa will add exact metric language.
2) Co-sell / partner-led definition: Ben to add explicit revenue attribution table into clause 3.1 and add 10% referral credit on cascade if Orbit is primary and closes the deal within 90 days.
3) Implementation SLA: Jordan confirms 40h of dedicated engineering support during pilot, with a two-week response SLA for critical integration issues (to be appended as Annex A).
4) Registration protection: 30-day deal registration notice from sign-off.

Next steps:
- Marissa to push updated Orbit_Account_Mapping.xlsx and final SOW redlines (DocuSign link) by 9/16 EOD.
- Liam to confirm DocuSign recipient list.
- Ben to prepare revenue attribution snippet for legal.

Attachments: (sent to DocuSign) Orbit_SOW_v1_final.pdf (DocuSign envelope prepped)
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/4981

If there are no objections in 24 hours we'll proceed to signature.

Thanks — Soojin
